story.text: 저녁을 든든히 먹고 나오니 규현이 골목 끝 노래방 간판을 가리켰다. "2차는 여기예요, 아가씨. 이의 있어요?"
story.reading: jeo-nyeog-eul deun-deun-hi meok-go na-o-ni gyu-hyeon-i gol-mok kkeut no-rae-bang gan-pan-eul ga-ri-kyeot-da. "i-cha-neun yeo-gi-ye-yo, a-ga-ssi. i-ui iss-eo-yo?"
story.en: After eating dinner until we were full, Kyuhyun pointed to a karaoke sign at the end of the alley as we stepped outside. "Round two is here, miss. Any objections?"

story.text: 작은 방에 들어서자마자 그는 리모컨을 낚아채더니 능숙하게 신청곡 번호를 눌렀다. "제일 먼저 부르는 건 접니다."
story.reading: jag-eun bang-e deul-eo-seo-ja-ma-ja geu-neun ri-mo-kon-eul nakk-a-chae-deo-ni neung-suk-ha-ge sin-cheong-gok beon-ho-reul nul-leot-da. "je-il meon-jeo bu-reu-neun geon jeom-ni-da."
story.en: The moment we stepped into the small room, he snatched up the remote and skillfully punched in a request number. "I'm singing first."

story.text: 전주가 흐르자 그는 마이크를 고쳐 잡고 눈을 지그시 감으며 낮고 굵은 목소리로 열창하기 시작했다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-ga heu-reu-ja geu-neun ma-i-keu-reul go-chyeo jap-go nun-eul ji-geu-si gam-eu-myeo nat-go gulg-eun mok-so-ri-ro yeol-chang-ha-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: As the intro played, he adjusted his grip on the mic, closed his eyes gently, and began singing his heart out in a low, deep voice.

story.text: 노래가 끝나자 나는 얼떨떨한 얼굴로 박수를 쳤다. "기장님, 이 정도면 딴따라 하셔도 되겠는데요?" 그는 헛기침을 하며 마이크를 슬쩍 내려놓았다.
story.reading: no-rae-ga kkeut-na-ja na-neun eol-tteol-tteol-han eol-gul-lo bak-su-reul chyeot-da. "gi-jang-nim, i jeong-do-myeon ttan-tta-ra ha-syeo-do doe-get-neun-de-yo?" geu-neun heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo ma-i-keu-reul seul-jjeok nae-ryeo-noh-at-da.
story.en: When the song ended, I clapped, my expression a mix of surprise and awe. "Captain, at this rate you could go pro." He cleared his throat and quietly set the mic down.

story.text: "그래서, 아가씨는 안 부를 거예요?" 그가 리모컨을 내밀며 씩 웃었다. 나는 마지못해 신청곡 하나를 눌렀다.
story.reading: "geu-rae-seo, a-ga-ssi-neun an bu-reul geo-ye-yo?" geu-ga ri-mo-kon-eul nae-mil-myeo ssik us-eot-da. na-neun ma-ji-mot-hae sin-cheong-gok ha-na-reul nul-leot-da.
story.en: "So? Aren't you gonna sing, miss?" He held out the remote with a grin. Reluctantly, I punched in a request of my own.

story.text: 막상 노래를 시작하자 음정이 제멋대로 흔들렸다. 규현이 참지 못하고 웃음을 터뜨렸다. "괜찮아요, 음치도 매력이죠."
story.reading: mak-sang no-rae-reul si-jak-ha-ja eum-jeong-i je-meot-dae-ro heun-deul-lyeot-da. gyu-hyeon-i cham-ji mot-ha-go us-eum-eul teo-tteu-lyeot-da. "gwaen-chan-a-yo, eum-chi-do mae-lyeok-i-jyo."
story.en: But once I actually started singing, my pitch wobbled all over the place. Kyuhyun couldn't hold it in and burst out laughing. "It's fine, being tone-deaf has its own charm."

story.text: 후렴구에서 그가 슬쩍 탬버린을 흔들며 화음을 넣어 주었다. 두 목소리가 맞아떨어지는 순간, 온몸에 소름이 돋았다.
story.reading: hu-lyeom-gu-e-seo geu-ga seul-jjeok taem-beo-lin-eul heun-deul-myeo hwa-eum-eul neoh-eo ju-eot-da. du mok-so-ri-ga maj-a-tteol-eo-ji-neun sun-gan, on-mom-e so-reum-i dod-at-da.
story.en: At the chorus, he quietly shook a tambourine and slipped in harmony. The moment our two voices lined up perfectly, chills ran down my whole body.

story.text: 곡이 끝나기 무섭게 규현은 다시 번호판을 두드렸다. "한 곡만 더요. 오늘 밤은 안 끝나요, 아가씨."
story.reading: gog-i kkeut-na-gi mu-seop-ge gyu-hyeon-eun da-si beon-ho-pan-eul du-deu-lyeot-da. "han gok-man deo-yo. o-neul bam-eun an kkeut-na-yo, a-ga-ssi."
story.en: The instant the song ended, Kyuhyun was already tapping out another number. "Just one more song. Tonight's not over yet, miss."

words.example_en: Shall we go to a karaoke room?
What's the number for the requested song?

words.meaning: a person who is tone-deaf, can't sing well
goosebumps, chills (often used as 소름 돋다, to get chills)
to sing passionately, with all one's heart
words.example_en: He sang his heart out on stage.

sentences.en: Can you tell me the song request number?
I got chills listening to that song.
I really sang my heart out today.
